product_intent: A small desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by a user's thumb

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid.
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb.
The box should be safe to use, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by a user's thumb

verification.observable: The lid remains closed until a thumb is applied to release mechanism
verification.condition: User applies thumb pressure to lid release mechanism

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe to use

verification.observable: No sharp edges, hazardous materials, or dangerous configurations present

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly process requires minimal tools and steps

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Manufacturing process can be completed using standard methods and materials

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized
The storage box must operate manually only

verification.observable: Product operates without any external power source or mechanical assistance

requirements.statement: The storage box must be designed for additive manufacturing

verification.observable: Design features are compatible with additive manufacturing processes

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Operation
operating_scenarios.description: User attempts to access storage box contents by applying thumb pressure to lid release mechanism

operating_scenarios.name: Assembly Process
operating_scenarios.description: Product is assembled using standard assembly procedures and minimal tools

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing Process
operating_scenarios.description: Product is manufactured using additive manufacturing processes

declared_absent.freedoms: No explicit freedoms were declared in the request or clarifications
declared_absent.relations: No conflicting, dependent, refining, or duplicating relationships identified between requirements
declared_absent.unknowns: No unknown quantities or unspecified requirements were identified in the request or clarifications
